tasks.question: What does 'netiquette' mean?
options: The unwritten rules of internet behavior

tasks.question: Is it okay to write in all capital letters on the internet?
options: Yes, because it is more visible
No, because it is considered shouting
Only if you are very happy

tasks.question: What should you do if you disagree with someone on a forum?
What is a 'troll'?
options: Someone who intentionally annoys others on the net

tasks.question: Is it okay to post a photo of someone else without permission?
options: No, you must ask for permission first
Only if they are your friend
Only if they don't see it

tasks.question: What is a 'flame war'?
options: A series of heated, hurtful arguments on the internet

tasks.question: What is an emoji for?
options: Helping to express emotions and the tone of the message

tasks.question: How should you greet in a formal email?
When is it worth sending an angry message?
options: Never, it is better to wait until we calm down
Only if many people see it

tasks.question: Is it okay to share other people's private secrets on the net?
options: Only if we do it anonymously

tasks.question: What should you do if you accidentally hurt someone online?
Why is spelling important in messages?
options: Helps avoid misunderstandings and shows respect

tasks.question: What is a chain letter?
options: A letter that must be forwarded to many people

tasks.question: Why shouldn't we send chain letters?
options: Because they are hard to type
Because they are annoying and unnecessarily burden the network

tasks.question: What is the most important rule on the net?
options: Treat others as you would like to be treated

tasks.question: What should you do if you see cyberbullying?
options: Tell an adult or help the victim

tasks.question: What should we pay attention to in group conversations?
options: Don't deviate too much from the topic and stay polite

tasks.question: Is it okay to make personal remarks to strangers?
options: Yes, because they don't know you anyway
No, you are talking to people on the internet too
Only if you have a bad day

tasks.question: What does 'ghosting' mean?
options: Cutting off contact with someone on the internet without a word

tasks.question: What is a good profile picture like?
options: One that doesn't reveal too much about you to strangers
Only a picture of your home

tasks.question: What is a 'tag' for?
options: Marking someone in a picture or post

tasks.question: When shouldn't you tag someone in a picture?
options: If they look good in it
If you haven't asked their opinion or it's embarrassing for them
You are always allowed to tag

tasks.question: What should you do if you get too many notifications?
What does 'spamming' mean in a conversation?
options: Sending many meaningless messages in quick succession

tasks.question: Why shouldn't we share fake news?
options: Because we misinform others and ruin our credibility
Because we get a penalty from Google

tasks.text: Netiquette is a collection of internet etiquette rules.
Do not write in all capitals, as it counts as shouting!
Treat others with respect on the internet too!
Ask for permission before posting a picture of anyone!
The internet doesn't forget, think about what you write!
Do not send unnecessary chain letters to your friends!
Politeness is a basic expectation in the online world too.
If you are bullied on the net, ask for help from an adult!
Be responsible in the digital world as well!
